name: Ton Yi Industrial Corp
summary: Ton Yi Industrial Corp. specializes in the production, processing, and global distribution of a diverse range of steel cans and tin plate products, operating across Taiwan, mainland China, and other international markets. The company supplies thin-gauge tin mill black plates and cold-rolled steel, which find application in manufacturing electrical and electronic components, household appliances, steel furnishings, various containers, and structural components. Furthermore, their tin plates and TFS (Tin-Free Steel) products are integral to food packaging, motor oil containers, electrical parts, dry cell batteries, stationery, and toys. They also manufacture tin cans specifically designed for a multitude of food and beverage products. Beyond metal packaging, Ton Yi produces PET (Polyethylene Terephthalate) containers for an assortment of beverages, including tea, fruit and vegetable juices, milk tea, coffee, and sports drinks. This offering is complemented by comprehensive sales and technical support. Moreover, the company supplies Tetra Pak packaging for items like tea, juice, and soy milk. Founded in 1969, Ton Yi Industrial Corp. maintains its corporate headquarters in Tainan, Taiwan. Initially established as Ton Yi Agriculture Industrial Corporation, the firm rebranded to Ton Yi Industrial Corp. in 1974.
